definition: [ טָרַד ] verb pursue, chase, be continuous (Arabic pursue ; II. prolong one's voice; VIII. continue uninterruptedly: Assyrian ‰arâdu , drive away COT Gloss , so Aramaic , טְרַד ) — only Qal Participle active וְדֶלֶף טֹרֵד Prov 19:13 a continuous dripping, dropping , i.e. one in which one drop pursues another; so טוֺרֵד ׳ ד Prov 27:15 in both simile of a contentious woman.
